findings.F1: On days with volume at least 2x the prior 20-day mean, the close location (from -1 at the low to +1 at the high) predicts the next day's unusual move against itself: the slope is -0.285 of the coin's usual 1-day move per unit of close location, t -4.68, on 1292 non-overlapping cases. It holds on both flat-body days (-0.323, t -2.25, n 341) and wide-body days (-0.276, t -4.12, n 951).
findings.F2: This one-day reversal grows with volume. The slope is -0.026 (t -1.51, n 8994) when volume is under its 20-day mean, -0.063 (t -2.25, n 4214) at 1-2x, and -0.285 (t -4.68, n 1292) at 2x or more. Across all days it is -0.066 (t -4.86, n 17379), and it stands out from the roughly 100 slopes and groups examined.
findings.F3: On heavy-volume days the reversal fades with the horizon and is gone by 5 days. The slope is -0.235 at 2 days (t -3.00, n 665), -0.188 at 3 days (t -1.89, n 447) and +0.189 at 5 days (t 1.82, n 275). This explains why the 5-day test of continuation found nothing (slope -0.00016, t -0.39, 369 cases).
findings.F4: There is no 5-day continuation graded by volume. The close location × log(volume ratio) interaction is -0.021 (t -0.44). On flat heavy-volume days alone the 5-day slope is 0.081 (t 0.28, n 66). The 5-day slope on days at 1.5x volume or more changes sign by year: 2018 -0.08, 2022 -0.11, 2020 +0.72 (t 2.13), 2023 +0.26 (t 2.02).
findings.F5: The tested book's total move per case is +0.12% against a 0.19% cost per trade. Its 366 long trades averaged +2.56% and its 291 short trades -3.52%, which matches the coins' upward drift rather than any timing. ZEC is the only coin with a positive mean trade (+2.66%, 146 trades).
findings.F6: Saturday's unusual daily return is +0.34% (t 4.08, n 2484), but it is negative in 2022 (-0.05%) and 2023 (-0.12%). It is not graded, so it is not carried into an idea.

ideas.idea: On a day when a coin's volume is far above its 20-day average, the closer its close sits to the day's high, the more the coin falls over the next 1 to 2 days, and the closer to the low, the more it rises. The effect is larger the heavier that day's volume is relative to its 20-day average.
ideas.consequence: A close at an extreme of the range on heavy volume is a reason to bet on a short pullback against it over the next day or two, not on continuation.
ideas.name: heavy-volume close-location reversal

ideas.idea: Over the next day, a coin moves against where its previous daily close sat in that day's high-low range: the nearer the close was to the high, the lower the next day's return.
ideas.consequence: A close near the day's high is a reason to refuse a next-day long, and a close near the low a reason to refuse a next-day short.
ideas.name: next-day close-location fade
